boundary: Discovery and source-review metadata only. No raw third-party payloads are committed and no canonical measured-value or independent-family count changes until existing rights, retrieval, semantic, fingerprint and profiling gates pass.

sources.name: NADINE / IJCNN transparent-part streaming injection-moulding quality dataset
sources.value: High-value independent multimodal quality/drift family with real injection-moulding observations and physical defect labels.

rights.reason: The paper explicitly published the dataset for reproducibility, but the original GitHub path is not currently resolvable through the connected repository service and the surviving mirror reviewed has no explicit licence file. Public mirroring is not treated as permission for raw ingestion or redistribution.

sources.nextAction: Locate an author-controlled surviving release or explicit dataset/code licence; then fingerprint and profile the exact archive with sequence/order and image-to-cycle linkage preserved.

sources.name: Ferromatik Milacron K85 mould pressure/temperature experimental workbook
sources.value: Potentially useful repeated-condition mould-sensor dataset for pressure/thermal response and process-repeatability learning.

rights.reason: Repository exposes the workbook but no explicit licence or authoritative original-data provenance was located in the reviewed repository.

sources.nextAction: Trace the workbook to its original publication/data owner and obtain explicit reuse terms before profiling.

sources.name: 16-cavity ABS cavity-pressure-to-part-mass quality study
sources.value: Strong measured evidence for cavity-specific pressure signatures, multicavity monitoring and mass prediction; directly supports pressure-to-quality learning.

rights.reason: The article is open access, but a separately licensed machine-readable raw dataset was not located during this pass.

sources.nextAction: Retain as publisher-verified article evidence; search author/institution repositories for the original 30-sensor traces before any raw-data count.

sources.name: MoldCAD paired injection-mould part and professional mould-assembly corpus
sources.value: Large net-new tooling/design evidence class for demould direction, parting, side-action and mould-assembly reasoning; complements process datasets rather than replacing measured process evidence.

rights.reason: The 2026 project page exposes MoldCAD and code links, but no repository-level licence file was found in the connected GitHub repository during this review.

sources.nextAction: Resolve the dataset hosting endpoint and licence/terms, then create a separate tooling-CAD contract with source hashes and train/eval split controls.

sources.name: Injection-production PC waste recycling dataset (Tarflon IR1900 origin)
materials: PC waste from Sartorius injection-moulding series production
sources.value: Useful supporting evidence for real injection-moulding waste provenance, PC drying and recycling-state changes; downstream FDM measurements must remain distinct from injection-cycle evidence.
sources.nextAction: Profile exact files and accept only directly measured fields with explicit stage identity; do not count downstream FDM rows as injection-moulding measurements.

sources.name: Injection-moulded PLA/ABS structural mechanical comparison dataset
sources.value: Direct physical-property outcomes on injection-moulded PLA and ABS specimens, useful for process-route comparison and material-learning examples.
sources.nextAction: Retrieve and fingerprint source files; isolate injection-moulded specimen rows from FDM rows and energy measurements before counting.

sources.name: Silica-coated mould-tool surface characterisation dataset
sources.toolingContext: Silica glass geometries adapted through metal casting for multi-sided injection-moulding tools.
sources.value: Adds measured tooling-surface and optical-characterisation evidence relevant to surface finish, insert/tool manufacture and demoulding-surface reasoning.
sources.nextAction: Profile the exact v3 ZIP and classify measurements as tooling/material characterisation, not injection-cycle process signals.

sources.name: Injection-moulding equipment effectiveness / SMED-TPM-5S operations dataset
sources.value: Potential operations/maintenance evidence for downtime, setup/changeover and equipment-effectiveness learning, separate from cavity/process physics.
sources.nextAction: Retrieve and profile exact files; accept only directly observed operations values and keep proposed/intervention/model calculations separate.
